ambient: Something is folded, checked and set aside.
The queue moves up by one.
A crease is pressed flat with a thumb that isn't a thumb.
description: A long counter, and something behind it's folding you down along creases that were already there, competently, into a shape that'll fit inside an ordinary day. It isn't unkind and it isn't rushed. There's a queue behind you and everything in it has been somewhere enormous.
name: The Posting Room

looks: Already there. You have been folded along them before.
They run through parts of you that didn't appear to be separate.
You go down small very neatly, and it doesn't hurt at all.
objects.name: the creases

looks: Patient. All of it has been somewhere it can't describe.
None of them look at each other, which appears to be the etiquette.
It isn't getting shorter, and it's moving.
objects.name: the queue behind you

weather: The draught along the counter comes from the ordinary day at the far end of it.
